budgetPolicy.rule: budgets is null until a real mesh is measured. The validator ACCEPTS null and REJECTS a bare number that has no measurement provenance. budgetPriors is advisory only and can never be enforced.
budgetPolicy.why: A fabricated number acquires authority by being committed — the same authority-acquisition path as the false evidence row this slice exists to correct. One prior was also internally implausible on inspection, which is evidence the set was transcribed rather than checked.

licensePolicy.note: Structured object, NOT a delimited string. The earlier `model:<name>@<version>:<license-id>` form was unsplittable when a model name contains @ or : — plausible for versioned/namespaced models. (HY3 P0 blocker 3, 2026-08-25.)

shape.modelName: required when kind=model; free string, no delimiter parsing
shape.licenseId: required when kind=model or ccby; SPDX id where one exists
shape.receiptPath: required when kind=model or ccby; path to the stored license receipt
